# Changelog
Version: NOT-CHECKED (REL-0001 receipt absent on this tree)

## Verified

- [CC-1] The catalog holds every row of the register snapshot: 103 items, 69 open, split A-toolchain 32 / HARNESS 10 / MONITOR 19 / B-workflow_design 8.
- [CC-2] Every item in the catalog is reachable from a final disposition: no dangling dependency, no cycle, no dead end, no phantom owner gate.
- [CC-3] The dependency graph cannot drift from the catalog.
- [CC-4] Closing an item costs the same one command as opening one.
- [CC-5] The register gate can never loop: it returns allow for every Stop-family event and for any re-entrant trigger.
- [CC-6] The gate fires on a stale catalog and is silent on a clean one, including the clean-partial case where only the matching program's items are closed.
- [CC-11] REACH-6 could be switched off by deleting a single field, and the gate would still print SUCCESS. Fixed 2026-08-13: validate.py now fails closed when provenance.register_sha256 is missing or empty.

## Not verified

Items below are withheld from the verified section. The status tag is inline beside each item.

- [INFERRED] [CC-7] The gate's firing rate is 2.4 fires per 20-prompt session -- at the calibration peer and far under the wallpaper line.
- [UNVERIFIED] [CC-8] The gate's advice is useful -- it surfaces the RIGHT item.
- [REJECTED] [CC-9] R-A02 (the 13-file command-center ledger) and R-H03 (reachability computable) are fully closed by this PR.
- [UNVERIFIED] [CC-10] The live ~/.agents/harness tree now carries this gate.
- [REJECTED] [CC-12] V-FIELDS -- 'all 19 Prompt Two fields resolve per item', listed as a check in validate.py's own docstring -- is enforced in CI.
